texts:
Sunday's news, team by team, from a trade in Houston to the backs, receivers and tight ends who got hurt.

Marvin Harrison Jr. is a Texan.

David Montgomery left with a groin injury.

Deebo Samuel Sr. hurt his hamstring.
#HTownMade #BirdGang #FTTB

Arizona traded Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston for a 2027 second and a sixth, and DeMeco Ryans confirmed it. He had 5 catches for 85 in four games.

WR43 rest of season for me. Hold him through his first two Houston games.
#HTownMade #BirdGang

Nico Collins is still Houston's top target. WR11 rest of season for me.

Michael Wilson keeps Arizona's outside targets with Harrison gone. WR40 rest of season for me; hold him.
#HTownMade #BirdGang

David Montgomery left in the second quarter at TEN with a groin injury after 5 carries for 11. RB21 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.
#HTownMade #TitanUp

Woody Marks was the only Houston back with a touch: 15 carries for 62 and 4 catches for 23.

C.J. Stroud went 26 of 34 for 260 with a TD in the air and one on the ground as DeMeco Ryans took over the play calls. QB18 rest of season for me.
#HTownMade

TreVeyon Henderson left the 45-17 win over LV with an ankle injury. RB26 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Rhamondre Stevenson ran for 64 and a TD. RB24 rest of season for me; hold him.
#NEPats #RaiderNation

Drake Maye went 26 of 34 for 374 with 4 TD passes and a rushing TD. QB11 rest of season for me.

Ashton Jeanty played through the ankle, and Las Vegas ran for 38 yards. RB8 rest of season for me; hold him.
#NEPats #RaiderNation

Fernando Mendoza came in for Kirk Cousins in the fourth quarter of a blowout, 6 of 8 for 48. That was mop-up work, not a benching.

Mendoza is QB32 rest of season for me; leave him on waivers in one-QB leagues.
#RaiderNation

T.J. Hockenson took a concussion on the first drive at NO, and Josh Oliver is out with a torn biceps. Minnesota is on bye in Week 6.

Hockenson is TE21 rest of season for me. Monitor; the protocol updates after the bye.
#Skol #Saints

Justin Jefferson caught 6 of 7 for 79 and a TD in his return from the ankle. WR6 rest of season for me.

Aaron Jones ran 25 times for 113 and a TD. RB32 rest of season for me; hold him through the bye.
#Skol

Kenyon Sadiq was ruled out of the 17-12 win over CLE with a concussion. TE19 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Garrett Wilson scored from 32 yards. WR13 rest of season for me.
#JetUp #DawgPound

KC Concepcion Jr. left in the first quarter vs NYJ with a head injury. WR41 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Isaiah Bond played 46 snaps and dropped all three targets. Leave him on waivers.
#DawgPound #JetUp

Roman Wilson was ruled out of the 34-22 win over IND with a finger injury. WR102 rest of season for me; drop him for any add.

Germie Bernard caught 6 for 80. WR84 rest of season for me, a deep-league add at 0 to 2 percent.
#HereWeGo #ForTheShoe

Jaylen Warren had 101 rushing yards and 87 receiving on 21 touches, his third straight game over 126 total yards. RB23 rest of season for me while Rico Dowdle (toe) sits; hold him.
#HereWeGo

Samaje Perine ran 14 times for 68 at MIA.

Chase Brown did not lead Cincinnati in carries for the first time this season. He has 22 carries for 49 the last two games. RB6 rest of season for me; hold him.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

Ja'Marr Chase came out of the concussion protocol and caught 6 for 77 with a 45-yard TD. WR1 rest of season for me.

Ollie Gordon II ran 18 times for 88 and a TD for Miami. RB43 rest of season for me; hold him.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

Tyson Bagent threw two picks in the 31-7 loss at GB and was pulled for Case Keenum in the fourth quarter.

Chicago hopes Caleb Williams is back for Week 6. QB10 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

Philadelphia ran for 22 yards in London after Will Shipley left with a foot injury. Shipley is RB56 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Saquon Barkley is RB9 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Deebo Samuel Sr. hurt his right hamstring in the third quarter @SEA and was ruled out. WR39 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Mike Evans is WR26 rest of season for me, with Ricky Pearsall out for the year.
#FTTB #Seahawks

Tre' Harris hurt his hamstring in the third quarter vs DEN after 2 catches for 16. WR63 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Ladd McConkey (foot) has barely played in two weeks. WR21 rest of season for me; hold him.
#BoltUp #BroncosCountry

Isaiah Likely caught a career-high 11 for 94 and 2 TDs in the 27-27 overtime tie with WAS. TE11 rest of season for me; hold him.

Jameis Winston threw 54 times for 326 and 3 TDs. QB33 rest of season for me; leave him on waivers in one-QB leagues.
#NYGiants #RaiseHail

Every item from Sunday is on the Pass, with the Harrison trade and the late-game injuries in.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Monday's leftovers and Tuesday's waiver run, and repost this for your league.
